toefl:se:477.answer: Thanks for understanding, and I apologize again for not being able to join you earlier.

toefl:se:477.japanese: 理解してくれてありがとうございます、そして早く合流できないことを改めてお詫びします。

toefl:se:480.japanese: カスタマーサービス様、
toefl:se:480.explanation: 宛先が個人名でなく部署名の場合の書き出し。
toefl:se:480.relatedInfo: Dear Customer Support, / To Whom It May Concern,

toefl:se:481.answer: I am writing to address an issue with my recent order from your store.
toefl:se:481.fullSentence: I am writing to address an issue with my recent order from your store.
toefl:se:481.japanese: 貴店での最近の注文に関する問題についてご連絡しています。
toefl:se:481.explanation: address an issue で「問題に対処する、問題について述べる」という意味。
toefl:se:481.relatedInfo: I'm writing to report a problem with / I'm contacting you about an issue with

toefl:se:482.answer: I purchased a set of books from your online store, but when my package arrived yesterday, I found that two of the books were missing and one was slightly damaged.
toefl:se:482.fullSentence: I purchased a set of books from your online store, but when my package arrived yesterday, I found that two of the books were missing and one was slightly damaged.
toefl:se:482.japanese: 貴店のオンラインストアで本のセットを購入しましたが、昨日荷物が届いたとき、本のうち2冊が欠けていて1冊がわずかに破損しているのに気づきました。
toefl:se:482.explanation: found that ~ で「〜だと気づいた」という発見を表す。
toefl:se:482.relatedInfo: I discovered that / I noticed that two books were missing

toefl:se:483.answer: I am very disappointed with the delivery because I was looking forward to reading all the books right away.
toefl:se:483.fullSentence: I am very disappointed with the delivery because I was looking forward to reading all the books right away.
toefl:se:483.japanese: すべての本をすぐに読むのを楽しみにしていたので、配送品にとても失望しています。
toefl:se:483.explanation: right away で「すぐに、直ちに」という意味の副詞句。

toefl:se:484.answer: Please send replacements for the missing books and also replace the damaged one.
toefl:se:484.fullSentence: Please send replacements for the missing books and also replace the damaged one.
toefl:se:484.japanese: 欠けている本の代わりを送っていただき、破損している本も交換していただけますようお願いいたします。
toefl:se:484.explanation: replacements for ~ で「〜の代替品」という意味の名詞句。
toefl:se:484.relatedInfo: send me replacement copies / provide a replacement for

toefl:se:485.answer: I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.
toefl:se:485.fullSentence: I would appreciate your prompt attention to this matter.
toefl:se:485.japanese: この件について迅速に対応していただけますと幸いです。
toefl:se:485.explanation: would appreciate ~ は丁寧に依頼するときの定番表現。
toefl:se:485.relatedInfo: I would be grateful for your prompt attention / thank you for your quick response

toefl:se:486.answer: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:486.fullSentence: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:486.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:486.explanation: look forward to ~ing はメールの結びによく使う定番表現。
toefl:se:486.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you.

toefl:se:487.japanese: 修理サービスチーム様、
toefl:se:487.explanation: 部署宛のフォーマルな書き出し。
toefl:se:487.relatedInfo: Dear Service Department, / To the Repair Team,

toefl:se:488.answer: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:488.fullSentence: I hope this email finds you well.
toefl:se:488.japanese: お元気でお過ごしのことと思います。
toefl:se:488.explanation: ビジネスメールの定番の書き出しフレーズ。
toefl:se:488.relatedInfo: I hope you are doing well. / I hope all is well.

toefl:se:489.answer: I am writing because after the recent service on my car at your shop, I have started to notice some unusual noises coming from the engine.
toefl:se:489.fullSentence: I am writing because after the recent service on my car at your shop, I have started to notice some unusual noises coming from the engine.
keyPhrases: unusual noises coming from the engine
toefl:se:489.japanese: 貴店で車の点検を受けた後、エンジンから異音がすることに気づき始めたためご連絡しています。
toefl:se:489.explanation: have started to notice で「〜に気づき始めた」という変化の始まりを表す現在完了。
toefl:se:489.relatedInfo: I've begun to notice / I've recently noticed

toefl:se:490.answer: The sounds were not present before the service, and I am concerned that there might be a problem that could affect the safety of driving the car.
toefl:se:490.fullSentence: The sounds were not present before the service, and I am concerned that there might be a problem that could affect the safety of driving the car.
keyPhrases: might be a problem that could affect the safety
toefl:se:490.japanese: その音は点検前にはありませんでした。そのため、車を運転する安全性に影響する可能性のある問題があるのではないかと心配しています。
toefl:se:490.explanation: that could affect ~ は problem を修飾する関係代名詞節。
toefl:se:490.relatedInfo: I'm worried it could be a safety issue / I fear this may compromise safety

toefl:se:491.answer: Because of this, I would like to request an appointment as soon as possible to have my car inspected again.
toefl:se:491.fullSentence: Because of this, I would like to request an appointment as soon as possible to have my car inspected again.
keyPhrases: would like to request an appointment
toefl:se:491.japanese: そのため、できるだけ早く車を再点検してもらう予約をお願いしたいです。
toefl:se:491.explanation: have my car inspected は「使役(have+目的語+過去分詞)」で「車を点検してもらう」という意味。
toefl:se:491.relatedInfo: I'd like to book an appointment / schedule a re-inspection

toefl:se:492.answer: Please let me know which days are available for you.
toefl:se:492.fullSentence: Please let me know which days are available for you.
toefl:se:492.japanese: どの日がご都合よろしいか教えてください。
toefl:se:492.explanation: available で「都合がつく、対応可能な」という意味。
toefl:se:492.relatedInfo: let me know your availability / which days work for you

toefl:se:493.answer: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:493.fullSentence: I look forward to your response.
toefl:se:493.japanese: お返事をお待ちしております。
toefl:se:493.explanation: look forward to ~ はメール結びの定番表現。
toefl:se:493.relatedInfo: I look forward to hearing from you.

toefl:se:494.explanation: Kind regards,はメールの結びに使う丁寧な定型表現。

toefl:se:495.answer: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:495.fullSentence: I hope this message finds you well.
toefl:se:495.japanese: 本メールがお元気なあなたに届きますように。
toefl:se:495.explanation: email の代わりに message を使った書き出しのバリエーション。
toefl:se:495.relatedInfo: I hope this email finds you well. / I hope you're doing well.

toefl:se:496.answer: I recently brought my car in for a routine service at your shop, and since then, I've noticed some unusual noises coming from the engine area.
toefl:se:496.fullSentence: I recently brought my car in for a routine service at your shop, and since then, I've noticed some unusual noises coming from the engine area.
keyPhrases: brought my car in for a routine service
unusual noises coming from the engine area
toefl:se:496.japanese: 最近、定期点検のために貴店に車を持ち込みましたが、それ以来エンジン付近から異音がするのに気づいています。
toefl:se:496.explanation: bring ~ in for a service で「点検のために〜を持ち込む」という表現。
toefl:se:496.relatedInfo: took my car in for servicing / had my car serviced

toefl:se:497.answer: The sounds are irregular, almost like a rattling or knocking noise, particularly when the engine is idling or during acceleration.
toefl:se:497.fullSentence: The sounds are irregular, almost like a rattling or knocking noise, particularly when the engine is idling or during acceleration.
keyPhrases: when the engine is idling or during acceleration
toefl:se:497.japanese: その音は不規則で、まるでガタガタ、あるいはカタカタという音のようで、特にエンジンがアイドリング中や加速中に聞こえます。
toefl:se:497.explanation: particularly when ~ で「特に〜のときに」と状況を限定している。

toefl:se:498.answer: I'm quite concerned about the safety implications of these noises.
toefl:se:498.fullSentence: I'm quite concerned about the safety implications of these noises.
toefl:se:498.japanese: この音の安全性への影響について、とても心配しています。
toefl:se:498.explanation: safety implications で「安全面への影響、意味合い」という意味。
toefl:se:498.relatedInfo: I'm worried about the safety risks of / concerned this could be unsafe

toefl:se:499.answer: I rely on my car for daily transportation, and I am worried that continuing to drive it might lead to further issues or even a potential breakdown.
toefl:se:499.fullSentence: I rely on my car for daily transportation, and I am worried that continuing to drive it might lead to further issues or even a potential breakdown.
keyPhrases: rely on my car for daily transportation
toefl:se:499.japanese: 日々の移動を車に頼っているため、このまま運転し続けるとさらなる問題や故障につながるのではないかと心配しています。
toefl:se:499.explanation: lead to ~ で「〜につながる」という結果を表す。
toefl:se:499.relatedInfo: could result in / might cause further problems

toefl:se:500.answer: Could I schedule an appointment to have it inspected again?
toefl:se:500.fullSentence: Could I schedule an appointment to have it inspected again?
toefl:se:500.japanese: もう一度点検してもらう予約を取ることはできますか?
toefl:se:500.explanation: Could I ~? は丁寧に依頼・許可を求める疑問文。
toefl:se:500.relatedInfo: Would it be possible to schedule / Can I arrange an appointment

toefl:se:501.answer: Please let me know when you have an available time.
toefl:se:501.fullSentence: Please let me know when you have an available time.
keyPhrases: let me know when you have an available time
toefl:se:501.japanese: ご都合のよいお時間があれば教えてください。
toefl:se:501.explanation: available time で「空いている時間」という意味。
toefl:se:501.relatedInfo: let me know your availability / what time works for you
